verdict.rationale: Alloy documents a transaction-monitoring workflow type. It monitors transaction events in real time or on a schedule, applies policy logic, and generates alerts when thresholds are met. Events can also be routed to Source Workflows for monitoring and interdiction. However, nothing shows thresholds being set per customer segment, or how a compliance officer authors and tunes the rules. missing for 10: segment-specific threshold configuration, documentation of the rule-authoring interface for compliance users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
